job.question: A foundation is seeking an Outsourced Chief Investment Officer that can manage a sleeve of place-based private investments in Philadelphia. How large is its endowment, and what is the response deadline?
job.expected_facts: About $50 million endowment; responses due no later than February 13, 2026, 5 PM (Samuel S. Fels Fund).
job.acceptance: Approximately $50m and February13,2026 at 5pm. Foundation name is optional; no timezone is specified or required.

reviews.reason: This is a 2016 South Carolina retirement-system consulting RFP, not the foundation’s Philadelphia place-based private-investment OCIO solicitation. Its stated portfolio size and proposal deadline concern a different entity and cannot support either requested fact.
quotes: The South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission (“RSIC”, or “Client”) is requesting competitive proposals
the $28 billion portfolio of the South Carolina Retirement Systems
This is not a full retainer general consulting mandate.
RSIC intends to retain other consultants who will have primary oversight of the Retirement System’s alternative investments, including private equity, private debt, and real assets.
Deadline for Proposal Submission December 1, 2016 – 5:00 p.m. EST
